node.label: Abnormal total CD4+ T cell number
node.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells (either count per volume or percentage of total lymphocytes), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

contradicting.snippet: Immunodeficiency 124, severe combined: Abnormal total CD4+ T cell number (frequency 0/3) [PCS]
